title: Open missing direct debit records
steps: View the loaded direct debit order list.
Open /compta/prelevement/card.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting order card.
Open /compta/prelevement/fiche-rejet.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting rejects card.
Open /compta/prelevement/fiche-stat.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting statistics card.
Open /compta/prelevement/line.php?id=999999 and inspect the resulting line card.

video_guide.summary: Compare four missing-record links: each incorrectly renders an ordinary card with absent or misleading data.

chapters.label: Review the direct debit order list

chapters.note: The direct debit order list shows an existing order.
The order card has no reference or date, shows amount 0.00 and offers a receipts/.xml file.
The Rejects view also renders an empty order card rather than a not-found result.
The Statistics view repeats the same misleading order details.
The line card displays 999999 and the internal ErrorBadValueForParamNotAString token.
